items.text: Bioinformatics vs biotechnology is a choice between computer-led analysis of biological data and lab-led experimental work, and the better fit depends on whether you prefer coding and statistics or hands-on experiments, with many roles blending both.
Try one small coding task on public biological data and one lab-style exercise and notice which you enjoy and do well.
Verify course content and avoid programmes promising guaranteed placements.
